task.title: Compact sticky email toolbar without unrelated changes

workflow_result.developer:
`ghost` is a valid borderless variant, so the edit renders as intended and verification passed.

## Change
`app/page.tsx` (rightmost column toolbar):
- Toolbar container: kept `sticky top-0` (added `z-10`, removed `space-x-4`).
- Removed the four bordered/padded wrapper divs (`border-r ... pr-4/px-4`) so the Mail, Trash, Reply, and Forward buttons sit directly next to each other with no margins or dividers.
- All toolbar buttons switched from `variant="outline"` (which carries `border border-input shadow-sm`) to `variant="ghost"`, removing button borders.
- Search stays right-aligned via `ml-auto`; same five toolbar options, same icons, same `p-4` / bottom-border / light-dark background treatment.

## Commands run
- `npm run verify:agent` → exit 0, `render smoke passed: HTTP 200, 27093 bytes`
- Read-only inspection of `components/ui/button.tsx` variants to confirm `ghost` exists (borderless).

## Remaining risks
- `ghost` buttons still use the default size (`h-9 px-4`), so icons have inherent padding rather than a tighter Mac-style icon-button width; appearance is borderless and adjacent, which was the stated requirement.
- No interactive test coverage of hover/sticky behavior beyond the render smoke check.

- `variant="ghost"` removes the previous outline button borders.
- The same five toolbar options remain: Mail, Trash, Reply, Forward, Search.
- Search remains right-aligned via `ml-auto`.
- The diff only affects toolbar layout/variant classes; no keyboard/focus, cancellation, persistence, loading/error/empty, or responsive-boundary behavior is changed by this patch.
- The listed remaining risks are visual fidelity risks, not regressions against the stated acceptance criteria.
